name: week
title: Service ownership week
subtitle: Fictional demo data when seeded. Evidence gaps need a responsible owner.

sections.title: Ownership review
sections.sql: select code,name,team,reviewed_on from catalog where lifecycle<>'retired' order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by service,kind,issue

sections.title: Assessments
sections.note: An exception records acceptance of a gap. It does not pass a check.
sections.sql: select service,standard,result,checked_on,has_exception from scorecard order by service,standard

sections.title: Recorded risks
sections.note: Direct dependencies recorded in this database, not a live topology scan.
sections.sql: select * from dependency_risk order by service,dependency
